s1.title: Who we are
s1.p1: {{brand}} is run by {{entity}}, {{address}}. We decide why and how your data is used, so under India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 we are the “Data Fiduciary” and you are the “Data Principal”.

s2.title: What we collect, and why
s2.p1: We collect only what these purposes need, and use it only for them.
s2.accountWhy: To create your account, sign you in, and reach you about your orders.
s2.addressesWhy: To deliver your orders and check that we deliver there.
s2.addressesKept: Saved addresses: until you delete them. On an order: with the order.
s2.ordersData: Orders: items, prices, taxes, coupons, store
s2.ordersWhy: To fulfil, bill and refund orders, and to keep the tax records the law requires.
s2.paymentsData: Payment references: Razorpay order and payment ids, method, status
s2.paymentsWhy: To confirm payments and refunds. Card numbers, UPI PINs and bank logins are typed on Razorpay’s page and never reach us.
s2.paymentsKept: As payment and tax law require.
s2.locationData: Location: the town you pick, or your current location when you tap “Use current location”
s2.locationWhy: To show what One Local offers where you are.
s2.locationKept: On your phone only, until you change it.
s2.locationSuggestionsWhy: To sort nearby places by distance without asking each time.
s2.locationSuggestionsKept: Not stored; used on your phone.
s2.profileExtrasData: Profile extras: photo, birthday, food preference, language
s2.profileExtrasWhy: To make the app feel like yours. You choose whether to add them.
s2.requestsData: Help requests, privacy requests, booking enquiries, “launch here” requests
s2.requestsWhy: To answer you and to learn where people want One Local.
s2.requestsKept: Until answered, then as our retention schedule says.
s2.deviceKeyWhy: Keeps orders placed without an account private to this phone. We store only a scrambled (hashed) form.
s2.deviceKeyKept: While the app is on your phone.
s2.voicePhotoWhy: Switched off today. If switched on, used only to find products, and not kept.
s2.marketingKept: Your choice is recorded, with the date and notice version.
s2.personalisationKept: Your choice is recorded, with the date and notice version.

s3.title: Who we share it with
s3.p1: We never sell your data. Anyone who handles it for us may use it only on our instructions, and must keep it safe.
s3.storeWho: The store or restaurant fulfilling your order
s3.storeWhat: The items, and the delivery address and notes for that order only.
s3.riderWhat: The delivery address, map pin and notes for the order they carry.
s3.supabaseWhat: Hosts our database and sign-in (account, orders, requests).
s3.razorpayWhat: Takes online payments; holds card, UPI and bank details under its own licence.
s3.smsWhat: Your mobile number, to send sign-in codes.
s3.googleMapsWhat: Address searches and map positions, to find your address.
s3.googleMapsWhere: Google’s servers, may be outside India
s3.osmWhat: A town-sized map area (no name or phone), to list local shops.

s4.title: Your choices, and taking them back
s4.p1: What is needed to deliver an order does not need a separate yes. Everything else is off until you switch it on:
s4.p2: To withdraw a consent, go to You → {{screen}} and switch it off: one tap, as easy as giving it. We stop within a reasonable time and tell anyone handling it for us to stop too. Withdrawing does not undo what was lawfully done before, and never affects your orders.

s5.title: Your rights
s5.seeBody: Download everything we hold about you, with who we shared it with.
s5.correctBody: Edit your profile any time, or ask us to fix anything else.
s5.deleteBody: Delete your account. We erase what we can at once and tell you what the law makes us keep.
s5.nominateBody: Name a person who can use these rights for you if you die or cannot act.
s5.complainBody: Raise a grievance with us; we answer within {{days}} days.
s5.p1: All of these are in You → {{screen}}. We may ask you to sign in first, so we know it is you.

s6.title: What we must keep
s6.taxLine: Tax invoices and order amounts (GST records): kept for the statutory period — under the GST law, 72 months from the due date of that year’s annual return. Your name, address and notes are removed from them.
s6.paymentsLine: Payment and refund records (Razorpay references, amounts, dates): kept as payment and tax law require. They no longer point to you.
s6.consentLine: Your consent history and privacy requests (what you agreed to, when, and what you asked us): kept so we can show we followed your choices.
s6.securityLine: Security logs: kept for one year, as the DPDP Rules require, then deleted.
s6.p1: Everything else is erased once it is no longer needed for the purpose you gave it for, or when you withdraw consent.

s7.title: Children
s7.p1: Accounts are for people aged {{age}} or older. A child can use One Local only through a parent’s or guardian’s own account. We do not track children’s behaviour or show them targeted advertising.

s8.title: Keeping it safe
s8.p1: Your data travels encrypted, is stored with {{hosting}}, and only our servers can read the database; the app on your phone cannot. Access is logged and the logs are kept for a year. If a breach ever affects your data, we will tell you and the {{board}} without delay, with what happened and what you can do.

s9.title: Questions and complaints
s9.p1: Our grievance officer answers questions about your personal data:
s9.p2: We reply within {{days}} days. If you are not satisfied, you can complain to the {{board}}: {{link}}. Please use our grievance process first; the Act asks for that.
s9.p2NoLink: We reply within {{days}} days. If you are not satisfied, you can also complain to the {{board}}. Please use our grievance process first; the Act asks for that.

s10.title: Changes and languages
s10.p1: When this notice changes, the version above changes, and we ask again wherever your consent is needed. You can ask us for this notice in Marathi, Hindi or any language in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution.
